narrative.intro: Sprezzatura Management Consulting has $240M in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Sprezzatura Management Consulting has 7 awards so far in FY2026, with an average award size of $34.3M. Sprezzatura Management Consulting's obligations were up 994.4% year over year. Historical obligations were much smaller before FY2026: FY21 $15.8M, FY22 $15.6M, FY23 $19.4M, FY24 $13.5M, and FY25 $21.9M. Spending in FY2026 is concentrated in a single NAICS market, with Custom Computer Programming Services accounting for $234M of obligations. Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services accounted for $5.6M, and Computer Systems Design Services accounted for $300K. Agency buying is concentrated as well: the Department of Veterans Affairs accounted for $241M in obligations. Current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date), and award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables are total contract values rather than obligations.
